displayName: System Binary Proxy Execution: Compiled HTML File

tests.name: Compiled HTML Help Local Payload
tests.description:
Uses hh.exe to execute a local compiled HTML Help payload.
Upon execution calc.exe will open

tests.name: Compiled HTML Help Remote Payload
tests.description:
Uses hh.exe to execute a remote compiled HTML Help payload.
Upon execution displays an error saying the file cannot be open

tests.name: Invoke CHM with default Shortcut Command Execution
tests.description: Executes a CHM file with the default Shortcut Command method.

tests.name: Invoke CHM with InfoTech Storage Protocol Handler
tests.description: Executes a CHM file with the ITS protocol handler.

tests.name: Invoke CHM Simulate Double click
tests.description: Executes a CHM file simulating a user double click.

tests.name: Invoke CHM with Script Engine and Help Topic
tests.description: Executes a CHM file with a defined script engine, ITS Protocol Handler, and help topic extension.

tests.name: Invoke CHM Shortcut Command with ITS and Help Topic
tests.description: Executes a CHM file using the Shortcut Command method with a defined ITS Protocol Handler, and help topic extension.

tests.name: Decompile Local CHM File
tests.description:
Uses hh.exe to decompile a local compiled HTML Help file.
Upon successful execution the chm file will decompile to disk.
